anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch, page 1) 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block, the two hierarchical labels NET0010 and NET0004 are both attached to the SAME node, which is the junction between the top plate of C5 (22n, bottom plate to GND) and the left terminal of R2 (1k, right terminal to A3 pin BTN). On the MCU these two labels sit on two different pins: NET0004 on pin 27 (PB5) and NET0010 on pin 29 (PB7).
anomalies.expected: The spec describes two separate nets: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)'. The 22 nF sampling capacitor must hang only off the PB7 sampling-capacitor pin, and the 1 kΩ series resistor only off the PB5 electrode pin; the two must not be joined.

evidence.quote: Touch block: GND—C5 22n—node(NET0010,NET0004)—R2 1k—A3 BTN (page 1, Capacitive Touch Button (TSC))
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN; TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)

anomalies.impact: PB5 and PB7 are shorted together and the sampling capacitor is placed in parallel with the series resistor/electrode instead of across the sampling-cap pin to GND. The STM32 Touch Sensing Controller Group-2 channel cannot charge/discharge correctly, so the capacitive touch button will not function (and the two MCU pins are mutually loaded).

anomalies.observed: On the display sheet (display.kicad_sch, page 5) the SSD1306/OLED pin named VCC (pin 28) is wired directly to the GND symbol (together with VSS pin 8 and VLSS pin 26), while the digital supply net VCC is instead connected to pin 9 (VDD). No 2.2 µF bypass is on the VCC-named pin.
anomalies.expected: The spec states 'C7 (2.2 µF) — U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin) to GND', i.e. the pin named VCC is the digital-logic supply rail and must sit on the VCC net (bypassed to GND by C7), not be hard-tied to GND.

evidence.quote: U1 pins 8 VSS, 26 VLSS, 28 VCC all tied to GND; pin 9 VDD tied to VCC (page 5, DISPLAY sheet)
C7 (2.2 µF) — U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin) to GND

anomalies.impact: If the symbol's VCC pin really is the logic-supply input, tying it to GND removes the display driver's logic supply and shorts that rail to ground, so the OLED would not power up. (Lower confidence: depends on whether this custom symbol's VDD/VCC naming matches the spec's reading of the netlist.)
